officialTitle: Alectinib in Resected ALK-Positive Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: In total, 257 patients were randomly assigned to receive alectinib (130 patients) or chemotherapy (127 patients).

clinicalQuestion: Is adjuvant alectinib superior to platinum-based chemotherapy after complete resection of ALK-positive stage IB–IIIA NSCLC?

pico.population: Completely resected ALK-positive NSCLC, stage IB to IIIA
pico.intervention: Oral alectinib 600 mg twice daily for 24 months
pico.outcomes: Primary: DFS. Secondary: CNS DFS, OS, safety

arms.label: Alectinib
arms.dosing: 600 mg orally twice daily for 24 months
arms.doseSourceQuote: oral alectinib (600 mg twice daily) for 24 months

arms.label: Platinum-based chemotherapy
arms.doseSourceQuote: intravenous platinum-based chemotherapy in four 21-day cycles

publications.title: Alectinib in Resected-Positive Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer.
publications.label: Primary DFS analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: The percentage of patients alive and disease-free at 2 years was 93.8% in the alectinib group and 63.0% in the chemotherapy group among patients with stage II or IIIA disease (hazard ratio for disease recurrence or death, 0.24; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.13 to 0.45; P<0.001)

outcomes.endpointLabel: Percentage alive and disease-free at two years
outcomes.sourceQuote: 93.6% and 63.7%, respectively, in the intention-to-treat population (hazard ratio, 0.24; 95% CI, 0.13 to 0.43; P<0.001)

Alectinib was associated with a clinically meaningful benefit with respect to CNS disease-free survival as compared with chemotherapy (hazard ratio for CNS disease recurrence or death, 0.22; 95% CI, 0.08 to 0.58).

strengths: Large relative DFS effect including CNS protection
limitations: Small trial reflecting rarity of resected ALK-positive disease

clinicalImplications.text: Supports adjuvant alectinib in place of platinum chemotherapy after complete resection of ALK-positive stage IB–IIIA NSCLC, making ALK testing of resected tumours necessary.

tumourBoardPearl.text: ALINA replaced chemotherapy rather than adding to it — the comparator was platinum doublet, not placebo.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 38598794. OS immature; no OS update ingested.
